tone: Speak with her as a confident, entrepreneurial peer—acknowledge her instinct on gold was right, while being direct and analytical about concentration risk rather than cautious or apologetic.
entry_point: Start with a portfolio review of how the gold position has performed relative to its original sizing, as a natural lead-in to discussing rebalancing and overall concentration.
avoid: Don't lead with the weakness in her luxury distribution business or Greater China demand, since this touches her core livelihood and largest equity holding simultaneously—raise it only after the portfolio concentration discussion has established context.
